root_cause: The customer could choose Azure OpenAI or Mistral and the repo had a verification helper, but no customer-scoped provider adapter ingress with authenticity protection against forged or stale runtime receipts.
prevention: Demand HMAC-signed, tenant/use-case/policy-version-bound receipts issued only after independent provider, data processing, egress and residency readback.
Reject all unprovisioned and mismatched routes; never derive an endpoint, model or AI provider from browser-supplied parameters.
Use fixed Azure OpenAI account FQDN or Mistral's canonical public endpoint only; never route to private/on-prem or airgapped systems through this shared cloud service.
Require exact storage and RAG placement match and preserve current Anthropic path untouched until verified opt-in configuration exists.
Preserve a single authorized request with no provider fallback and no fabricated data processing, CSRD materiality, EU guarantee or measured financial/environmental value.

evidence.outcome: Signed cloud provider adapter path and authenticated opt-in ingress implemented as fail-closed candidate. Live provider credentials, issuer provisioning, registered evidence and authorized end-to-end execution are NOT claimed.
